reviews.text: They examined my kitten but they didn't understand the problem and I had to go to another veterinary clinic.

Serious professionals who care for animals with love. A special thanks to Dr. Sarli, who took such great care and attention to treating my cat. A well-trained and kind staff, from the secretaries to the nurses. ❤️
Dr. Testa is very competent, meticulous, and affable.

A welcoming, clean, well-organized facility with various specialists. Dr. Guerriero, whom I had the opportunity to meet more than 11 years ago, is a true luminary of Veterinary Medicine (Ophthalmology). She is attentive and scrupulous and carries out her work with dedication and passion. She cares about the health of her patients; she follows them meticulously, advises the client, directs them. It is not easy to manage the owners either, in short, she is THE BEST!!. She treated a very painful corneal erosion in my cat, always offering the best possible care for the good of the patient and thus obtaining an excellent result. Dr. Guerriero has also treated various problems of my pets, always obtaining excellent results. Humanly speaking, she is an exceptional, helpful, humane person. I contacted her on Christmas Eve and she was extremely helpful. A doctor who is not at all venal. I will always thank her and would not change her for anyone. I highly recommend her; your furry friends will be in very good hands if they need it.

I've had the fortune of knowing Dr. Alessandra Guerriero for many years, and I can say without a doubt that she is an extraordinary professional, both medically and personally.
She cared for my dog ​​Gioietta with great dedication, accompanying us on a delicate and not always easy journey. Despite the loss of her sight due to a tumor, thanks to her attentive care, expertise, and sensitivity, she repeatedly managed to give her small moments of light, concretely improving her quality of life.
But what makes her truly special is her humanity: always available, at any time, even on vacation, ready to answer, listen, and help. She is a rare person, who goes beyond her own specialty but takes every situation to heart, also offering support and referrals to other professionals when necessary.
Professional, serious, deeply empathetic: a true lady, even before being an excellent veterinarian.
I will always be grateful to her.

An extremely negative experience. Veterinarian Guerriero proved to be unreliable, unconscientious, and completely unprofessional. I had the strong impression of a venal approach, more concerned with financial considerations than the true well-being of the animals.

In a profession that should require competence, responsibility, and above all sensitivity, I instead encountered superficiality and a lack of humanity. Such an attitude is deeply disappointing, especially when you're entrusting someone with the health of an animal.

Personally, I wouldn't recommend her.

Welcoming, clean, and professional environment... My THANK YOU goes to everyone who works there, but a SPECIAL THANK YOU goes to Dr. Aldo Ciarnelli, who with care, dedication, and love has always resolved every problem I encountered with my beloved Thiago, down to the smallest detail. Thank you so much for your support and care!!!

Thiago🐾 and Valentina ❤️

To Clivet, with infinite gratitude ❣️
There are places that aren't just spaces, but refuges for the soul. And there are people who, with their knowledge and humanity, can make a difference in the most delicate moments. Clivet is one of these places. Dr. Aldo is one of these people.
We have always placed our trust in him, but this time our thanks are even deeper. When our beloved Giulia—an irreplaceable part of our family—needed treatment, Dr. Aldo welcomed her with the kindness of someone who truly understands how much love there is in a four-legged gaze. He observed, listened, understood. He was able to promptly identify the right diagnosis, and with the same caring attention, he created the treatment plan that brought Giulia back to health ☀️
Today Giulia is well ❤️, and if her gaze has returned to serenity, if her energy is alive again, we owe it to him and to the entire extraordinary Clivet team.
Aldo isn't just an excellent veterinarian: he's a man who practices his profession with passion, empathy, and a profound respect for life. And his staff reflects the same values, working with dedication and kindness, always.
Thank you, truly. For caring for Giulia, for guiding us with sensitivity, for making us feel understood and never alone.
Your presence has been a gift. 💝
With affection and sincere gratitude.

Zero humanity. Zero animal lovers. They only care about money. My cat in the emergency room was barely breathing, and they turned me away because they only see patients by appointment. I begged them to at least give her a syringe of antibiotics, but they didn't tell me they were closing time with half an hour to go. They're kind and professional only when they have to do things that require a lot of money. Truly, they're inhumane vets.
Dottoressa Guerriero is amazing! Highly recommend this vet. She took good care of our dog and prescribed good medications. She cares about her clients. We will continue to use her services. 🙏 …

They are all very good, I personally had the opportunity to appreciate the great professionalism and experience of Doctor Orlando, who treated my dog ​​with so much love, and in a few seconds she understood what her problem was.
My dog ​​Flick was operated on by Dr. Ciarnelli and is now well thanks to the staff.
